en: Sunset falling, on Ocean Drive
zh: 夕阳落在海洋大道上

en: The city wakes and the streets come alive
zh: 城市醒来，街道渐渐鲜活

en: The pink hotels turn on their neon lights
zh: 粉色酒店亮起霓虹

en: The radio keeps playing through the night
zh: 收音机整夜不停播放

en: The whole bay glitters, the palm trees sway
zh: 海湾闪耀，棕榈轻摇

en: The traffic rolls like a slow-moving wave
zh: 车流像缓缓涌动的海浪

en: Headlights stretch out on the road to the Keys
zh: 车灯延伸向群岛的公路

en: The ocean wind blows through the banyan trees
zh: 海风穿过榕树的枝叶

en: Vice City, one hell of a ride
zh: 罪城，这一路何等疯狂

en: The sun goes down and the streets come alive
zh: 太阳落下，街道开始苏醒

en: Fast cars rolling, with the windows down
zh: 跑车飞驰，车窗尽情敞开

en: Anything can happen in this town
zh: 在这座城，一切皆有可能

en: Vice City, one hell of a ride
zh: 罪城，这一路何等疯狂

en: The summer is hot and the nights are long
zh: 夏日滚烫，长夜漫漫

en: Every street corner is singing our song
zh: 每个街角都在唱我们的歌

en: Out on the road, wild and free, where we belong
zh: 奔向公路，狂野自由，那是我们的归处

en: Perfect smiles shine on every screen
zh: 每块屏幕都闪着完美笑容

en: They sell you sunshine for a monthly fee
zh: 他们按月收费，向你兜售阳光

en: The streets stay hungry while the billboards shout
zh: 广告牌高声叫卖，街头依旧饥饿

en: Somebody's winning as the lights go out
zh: 灯光熄灭时，总有人赢得一切

en: The gates are golden, the streets are gray
zh: 大门金光闪闪，街道却灰暗

en: Tomorrow belongs to whoever pays
zh: 谁付得起钱，谁就拥有明天

en: Today's big scandal is tomorrow's ad
zh: 今天的丑闻，明天就成了广告

en: The whole town buys it and calls it a fact
zh: 全城照单全收，还称它为事实

en: When the pretty lights go out along the shore

en: All the dreamers wake up wanting something more
zh: 所有做梦的人醒来，仍渴望更多

en: Let the ocean take the names we couldn't save
zh: 让海洋带走那些我们留不住的名字
